name: Maldraz
summary: Maldraz is a massive great tree situated within the Blasted Lands. Rooted amidst an otherwise scarred and demon-blighted wasteland, the colossal bough stands as a poignant reminder of nature's perilous struggle against dark corruption.

sections.title: A Beacon in the Blight
sections.body: Rising in the southern reaches of the Blasted Lands near the tainted wastes, Maldraz is an immense tree cultivated to channel druidic energies into an environment devastated by demonic magic. While much of the Blasted Lands lies stripped of natural life following the opening of the Dark Portal, Maldraz represents a desperate effort to plant living roots deep within the corrupted soil and draw pure essence back into the shattered landscape.

sections.title: The Creeping Taint
sections.body: Nurturing verdant life in soil soaked with nether energies is fraught with profound peril. The ambient demonic residue clinging to the surrounding earth seeps relentlessly into living bark and foliage. Travelers who draw near Maldraz witness a constant tension: the noble yearning of living wood battling the insidious corruption that permeates the region's blackened earth.

faq.answer: Maldraz is a colossal great tree located in the Blasted Lands. It serves as a focal point of living nature and verdant growth in a region overwhelmingly scarred by demonic contamination.

faq.q: Why is there a giant tree in the Blasted Lands?
faq.answer: The tree was seeded and nurtured as an attempt to introduce resilient botanical life into the blighted expanse, defying the barren desolation left behind by dark portal energies.

The surrounding landscape remains dangerous and unpredictable. While the tree itself represents natural life, the pervasive demonic aura of the Blasted Lands continuously threatens any untended wilderness in the zone.

faq.q: Can nature really survive in the Blasted Lands?
faq.answer: The soil of the Blasted Lands is severely drained and corrupted by fel energies, making standard plant life almost impossible to sustain. Sites like Maldraz demonstrate that powerful nature magic can take root, though holding back the persistent corruption is an unending struggle.

angles.text: Seeing a great tree standing against the demonic taint of the Blasted Lands is both an inspiring testament to nature's tenacity and a stark warning of how easily living roots can become poisoned.
